# Appendix D: Meta-Analysis of Velocity Estimates {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-important}
This appendix has been withdrawn from the active manuscript draft.

The earlier "meta-analysis of velocity estimates" summarized invalidated
pre-fix subgroup results and should not be used as current evidence. A
replacement appendix will be created only if regenerated corrected
subgroup estimates warrant synthesis.
:::

## Why This Appendix Was Removed

The previous version of Appendix D aggregated estimates that were produced
before the quarter-based duration correction. Because the underlying
heterogeneity results were not trustworthy, any pooled summary, ranking,
or narrative built from them was also untrustworthy.

## Current Rule

No meta-analytic summary should appear in the manuscript until:

1. subgroup models are rerun from the cleaned standardized workflow
2. manuscript tables match the current diagnostics
3. the remaining signals are strong enough to justify synthesis rather
   than being reported only as exploratory checks

Until that work is complete, the authoritative project summary lives in
`doc/PROJECT_STATUS.md`.
